scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && uv sync --directory chat
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,chat -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "uv run --directory chat uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 --reload"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,chat -c magenta,green "npm start --prefix backend" "uv run --directory chat uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend && uv run --directory chat pytest -q
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend && uv run --directory chat ruff check . && uv run --directory chat ruff format --check .
